title: Configuration encoding ports
statement: For a natural number $k$, define the ports used to encode a machine configuration: a state, the input-head position and scanned input symbol, a head position for each work tape, a port for each work-tape index and Boolean symbol, a summary port for each Boolean value, and old-bit and new-bit ports.
